acceptance_criteria_satisfied.how: assertC0_3P first line: `if (m.groupId === null || !m.memberA || !m.memberB || !m.memberC) return;` — runs only when all three are members of the shared group, otherwise returns silently.

Builds idSets for A/B/C and runs a full pairwise loop asserting idSets[j].has(id) for every id in idSets[i] (i≠j). Then, per shared task id, asserts B's and C's status/assignee/title equal A's copy (transitive across all three). This block needs no hooks — it is the degraded-form floor.

Reads membersA/B/C via getGroupMembersHook(r.page(a), groupId) for a∈[A,B,C]; asserts each is non-null; asserts memberSets.B equals memberSets.A and memberSets.C equals memberSets.A (pairwise ⇒ all three equal).
Reads epochA/B/C via getGroupEpochHook(r.page(a), groupId); asserts epochB === epochA and epochC === epochA.

Builds unionMembers = Set(membersA ∪ membersB ∪ membersC); for each p, reads lcA/lcB/lcC via getPubkeyLeafCountHook(r.page(a), groupId, p) and asserts lcB === lcA and lcC === lcA. Gated by leafCountHookPresent (strict path always taken today).

For each of m.pubkeyA/B/C: isMember = membersA.includes(p) (membersA from getGroupMembersHook on pageA), leafCount = getPubkeyLeafCountHook(pageA, m.groupId, p); strict asserts isMember === (leafCount >= 1). All reads scoped to m.groupId so cross-group leftover leaves cannot false-negative.
Walks each of m.epochSequenceA/B/C; for i from 1, asserts seq[i] >= seq[i-1]. Cross-actor epochs are NOT compared.

Guard `if (m.lastSwitched === null) return;`. Reads loadedGroupIds = __notestrTestGroups().map(g => g.idStr) on the post-switch context (r.page(context)); for each gid asserts priorGroupIds does NOT contain gid.

For each member actor with a known own pubkey: deviceRows = page.locator('[data-testid="device-row"]').count(); strict asserts deviceRows === getPubkeyLeafCountHook(page, m.groupId, ownPubkey). Per-actor over [A,B,C], each on its own page.

Degraded fallbacks present-but-dormant: C0 returns after the task-subset block when !strictHooksPresent / !leafCountHookPresent; S5 does positive-only (member ⇒ ≥1 leaf) when !leafCountHookPresent; S10 asserts >= 0 when !leafCountHookPresent; S6/S7 are hook-independent and identical in both forms. All gated by always-true probes today, so strict is the live path.

A section-header comment block above the assertions and a top-of-function comment in each of assertC0_3P/assertS5_3P/assertS6_3P/assertS7_3P/assertS10_3P name AC-3P-DEG-2 and point at epic-property-tests-l3-completion's test-hook story.
